name: Water quality cost-effectiveness analysis [Nov 2022]
summary: Chlorinates drinking water through in-line chlorinators and dispensers at water points, in Kenya and elsewhere. GiveWell's spreadsheet "Water quality cost-effectiveness analysis [Nov 2022]", linked from 4 of its grant pages. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.
